definition: A fully specified re-measurement of spatial autocorrelation on the shipped frame, plus a measured inventory of the served spatial asset and the frozen legacy text. The unit that carries reproducible memberships is the planning area: the served asset is keyed by planning area, so the pack produces its memberships there — 41 areas after the recorded floor, KNN k=8 row-standardised weights on unweighted-mean centroids (one connected component, zero islands, both recorded), appreciation defined as the median-psf ratio of the trailing 12 completed months against the preceding 12, both windows stopping at the measured cutoff, 999 permutations at a fixed seed, and Benjamini-Hochberg correction at q=0.05 before any high-high label is assigned. Under that protocol the appreciation screen shows NO significant clustering (area-level Moran's I is slightly negative and not significant; the point estimate and its p-values are ledger fields), which is measured evidence about THIS protocol, not a refutation of the legacy's number: the legacy's variable is unstated (its appendix aggregates median monthly_rent on an input file that is absent from this checkout, while its prose interprets appreciation), so its 0.766 is recorded as stated and dispositioned not-reproducible, and the transition/persistence claims are withdrawn outright because no linked asset carries a time dimension. The point-level layer is a price-LEVEL screen on coordinates that resolve to 13,562 distinct pairs: its KNN graph fragments into thousands of disconnected components, which is recorded as the disconnected-areas metadata the gate requires, and its significance is carried by a seeded 20,000-row subsample rather than by the analytic normal approximation alone. No layer of this pack predicts future returns or demand, and no layer claims how any series was produced: everything is screened as.
